title: Community events — Final Review
summary: All accepted prototypes, settled decisions and the final specification in one last review gate.
heading: Review the complete proposal before implementation is considered.
intro: A Final Review is mandatory. It consolidates every accepted mockup, every prior decision and the generated specification. Acceptance still does not authorize a build.

principles.title: Nothing disappears
principles.detail: Every source mockup and decision remains inspectable.

principles.title: Contradictions are visible
principles.detail: The final record must not silently choose between conflicting rounds.

principles.title: Separate build gate
principles.detail: Final Review acceptance is followed by an explicit implementation question.

mocks.title: Round 1 · Coordinator dashboard
mocks.description: The accepted coordinator queue and event selection flow.

mocks.title: Round 1 · Guest registration
mocks.description: The accepted guest selection and consequence-preview flow.

decisions.title: Landing priority
decisions.outcome: Lead with the action queue and retain programme totals as an orientation strip.

decisions.title: Registration confirmation
decisions.outcome: Always show a lightweight preview; escalate only when capacity or layout is affected.

decisions.title: Design sequence
decisions.outcome: Test the workflow at mobile width before implementation specification approval.

artifacts.title: Final specification
artifacts.description: The complete implementation input generated from the accepted review decisions.

artifacts.title: Community events implementation roadmap
artifacts.description: A reusable structured roadmap with phases, agents, evidence and commits.

questions.title: Does this Final Review faithfully represent the agreed design?
questions.prompt: Acceptance closes design only. Implementation still requires a separate explicit instruction.
questions.recommendation: Accept only if every mockup, settled decision and specification section is present and consistent.

options.label: Accept Final Review
options.detail: Close design and proceed to the separate build-authorization question.

options.label: Request corrections
options.detail: Correct consolidation or specification errors without reopening design unnecessarily.

options.label: Open another round
options.detail: A material design change becomes a new numbered round, followed by a replacement Final Review.

handoff.complete: Final Review is complete. Do not implement until the reviewer separately and explicitly authorizes the build.
handoff.inProgress: Final Review remains in progress. Do not ask to begin implementation yet.
